dish: roux-based soup curry built on a Western-trained chef's broth
n: Curry Shokudō Kokoro Sapporo Honten (カレー食堂 心 札幌本店)
address: City Heim N15 1F, Kita 15-jō Nishi 4-chōme 2-23, Kita-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: A neighbourhood soup-curry house near Hokkaido University since 2001 — a roux-based broth from a chef with a yōshoku background; a 4-minute walk from Kita-18 Station.

dish: jingisukan of 'Roaring Forties' lamb and fresh lamb shoulder loin
n: Jingisukan Yōyōtei Sapporo Honten (ジンギスカン羊々亭 札幌本店)
address: Matsuoka Bldg 5F, Minami 4-jō Nishi, Chūō-ku (Susukino), Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: A Susukino lamb hall beside Susukino Station exit 2 — six cuts of lamb from rolls to chops grilled on the dome, plus lamb shabu-shabu.

dish: original soup curry with big vegetable and chicken pieces
n: Niseko Curry Koya (ニセコ カリー小屋)
address: Niseko Hirafu 5-jō 2-chōme 2-11, Kutchan, Abuta District, Hokkaido, Japan
w: A Hirafu soup-curry pioneer opened in 1988, when Sapporo itself had only a handful — rich-yet-light house broth, generous chunks; lunch only, sells out. Its retort curry is a Kutchan souvenir.
